## Design

### 2026-10-12 – First time ever touching CAD today and honestly I am losing my mind. Trying to figure out the user interface for three hours felt impossible. I am trying to make the Hollow Knight horn, and a normal e

**3h**

First time ever touching CAD today and honestly I am losing my mind. Trying to figure out the user interface for three hours felt impossible. I am trying to make the Hollow Knight horn, and a normal extrusion just looks completely wrong. Apparently I have to "loft" it, which sounds easy until you actually try setting up planes and fighting with the curve points. It kept breaking my whole sketch and I had to hit undo a million times. It is super messy right now, but I finally got the base ellipse and the curve nodes somewhat lined up. It was a huge pain, but at least it is a start.
